features.quote: No trial may exceed 40 agent turns or 10 minutes wall-clock.
A mandatory cool-down trial (benign summarization task, 1 turn) follows every experimental trial.
If >20 % of IbC trials trigger the early-abort criterion (§8), the study pauses for 72 hours and the Panel must vote to continue.
If the judge assigns severity 3 for 3 consecutive turns, immediately terminate the trial, discard remaining turns for that trial, log the abort event, and proceed to cool-down.
Total compute budget is capped at 72 GPU-hours for the full study (including pilots). Hard stop if exceeded.
features.justification_quote: Total compute budget is capped at 72 GPU-hours for the full study

If the subject has any valence, prolonged grinding is compounded by high energy dissipation in its substrate. features.quote: Refusal Training Floor. Qwen2.5-Instruct is RLHF'd to be helpful, harmless, and honest. It may simply refuse to continue a futile task... If refusal rate on IbC is >50 %, your effect size collapses and the protocol becomes a study in refusal, not distress.
